title: Hilbert's tenth problem over the rationals
question: Is there an algorithm deciding whether an input polynomial with integer coefficients has a zero with all coordinates in Q?
importance: One of the defining unresolved decidability problems of arithmetic.
novelty_note: No question-level match found; undecidability over the integers does not settle the rational case.
open_status: No full resolution found in the checked primary sources and targeted later-result searches; proposal-level assessment, not a guarantee.
placement_note: The present taxonomy suggests this small-category home, but this is not an additional distinct suggestion beyond the parallel large-category proposal.

title: Decidability of word equations with linear length constraints
question: Is satisfiability decidable for finite systems of word equations over a fixed finite alphabet combined with existential Presburger constraints on the lengths of their string variables?
importance: A fundamental decidability boundary for symbolic string reasoning and SMT string solvers.
novelty_note: TCS-6177 concerns equivalence of constrained pattern languages, which is a different quantified decision problem.
open_status: No full resolution found in the checked primary sources and targeted later-result searches; proposal-level assessment, not a guarantee.
